definitions: A close-fitting jacket, with or without sleeves, worn by men in the Renaissance.
One of a pair of similar things.
A word that has the same etymological root as another word but has come into English by a different route.
A synthetic gemstone made of two parts, typically a valuable upper part and a less valuable lower part.
examples: The two words are a doublet.
The jeweler identified the ring as a doublet.
